correctness.rationale: The class intersection pairing produces a connected 27-vertex degree-ten graph. Its 135 pair intersections are distinct ordinary nodes by the no-Eckardt hypothesis. Over the r-th extension the point count is (q^r+1)V_r+E_r−B_r, since a rational normalization component is a projective line over the finite field, and normalization replaces each rational node by its fixed branches. The normalization quotient also identifies the rank-109 character lattice with integral graph cycles, so the signed edge and vertex determinants give det(q−F | H1), the exact torus order. An independent replay of the eleven conjugacy representatives agrees with every CSV field, including the split and nonsplit rational nodes. The eleven line orbit vectors are distinct and their denominator poles lie on |t|=1/q, separated from all other possible factors at |t|=1, so the eleven zeta expressions are distinct. The two point-free types and the special displayed formulas agree. The proof uses q^r when powering Frobenius and det(q−F), notwithstanding shorthand in the Finding.
residual_risks: No realization for each field or integral isomorphism classification of the torus is proved or required.

evidence: For every r take the row λ(F^r) to get V_r, E_r=n1+3n3 and B_r=6n3. Inverse divisor sums recover v_d,e_d,b_d. Returning node branches satisfy b_d=2p_d+n_{d/2}, with the last term zero at odd d; hence p_d and n_d=e_d−p_d are recovered recursively. Normalization and the signed cycle determinant then give the zeta and torus orders without any new orbit computation.

originality.rationale: The decisive distinct indexed record is Frobenius orbit spectra of cubic-surface tritangent flags [84e77c75d6b3]. Its actual table for the same eleven six-point blowup types provides not only the identical line spectra but also counts of rational tritangent planes with 0, 1 and 3 rational lines, for every type. These data are equivalent to the signed-node and branch census on the no-Eckardt locus by the complementary-pair bijection. Applying the exact existing table to the type of each Frobenius power gives all point counts, all orbit columns and the torus determinant by standard normalization and the graph exact sequence. This is a finding of mathematical coverage, not an assertion of chronological priority between same-day records.
residual_risks: Hirschfeld chapter full text was unavailable; coverage is established independently by the accessible tritangent table. Same-day chronology is unresolved and not used.

value.rationale: A zeta census and nonsplit nodes for this natural divisor are meaningful questions, but the submitted contribution has no independently needed unknown invariant left after converting the exact tritangent table. Substituting the same discrete data into the general normalization and signed-graph formulas is a useful presentation, not a distinct substantive result. No claim about finer integral torus structure is proved that could survive as a narrower finding.
residual_risks: An integral lattice classification or a treatment of degenerations would be different claims, not repairs established by this evidence.
